name: @blueprint/cited-url-lint
description: Verifies that HTTP(S) URLs cited in docs/ resolve (don't 4xx). Catches the failure mode where prose claims point to fabricated or stale documentation paths.
//: No dependencies. Uses node:fetch (Node 20+). tsx + vitest picked up from workspace via npx. Intentionally outside npm workspaces graph (matches frontmatter-lint shape). The lint scripts cd to the project root because the tool resolves relative paths against the working directory, and npm runs scripts from this package's directory.
